items.name: 1v1 showdown
items.description:
🎮 FACIT CS2 Event – Competition, Strategy, and Community

The FACIT CS2 Event is an exciting esports tournament in Counter-Strike 2, bringing together players of all skill levels to compete in intense and tactical matches. The event emphasizes teamwork, precision, and strategy, giving participants the opportunity to showcase their skills in a competitive, tournament-style environment.

🏆 Format

The tournament is played in either a knockout or group stage format, depending on the number of participating teams. All matches follow the classic 5v5 format, where teams battle their way through the bracket to reach the final and claim the FACIT title.

🎯 Purpose
To create a fun and competitive environment for CS2 players
To strengthen the gaming community
To provide both new and experienced players with tournament experience
🎧 Atmosphere

The event features live commentary, high-energy matches, and an engaged audience—either online or in person. The atmosphere is competitive but fair, with a strong focus on sportsmanship.

🧠 Requirements for Participants
Minimum of 5 players per team
Stable internet connection and a valid CS2 account
Respect for fair play and tournament rules
